## Checklist
<!-- See CONTRIBUTING.md. -->
- [ ] The plugin installs from the zip and works
- [ ] `id` and `version` are the same as in the manifest
- [ ] `permissions` and `storage_mb` are copied from the manifest
- [ ] `sha256` is the SHA-256 of the zip at `url`
- [ ] `url` is a release asset of `repo`
- [ ] `icons/<id>.png` is the same file as `icon.png` in the zip
- [ ] `plugins.json` is valid JSON
